body:
The modification here causes `is_tool_scene_open_available` to always be `false`.

I am not sure of your intentions, but you might need to unify the behavior of keyboard shortcuts and context menus.

I think you can search for `is_tool_scene_open_available`, `TOOL_SCENE_OPEN`, and `TOOL_SCENE_OPEN_INHERITED` in your code editor or IDE to confirm whether the changes brought about by the PR are the behavior you expected.
This is a typo from undoing the fix for "Open in Editor (inherited)", which was not present in my initial commit. Thanks.
Not sure if the comment is necessary.
Since the fix involves just removing the condition, you can include it here.
